name: Fleurette
summary: Fleurette is a 3D-platformer game that is inspired by the classic flash game Anika’s Odyssey. You play as a village girl, Fleurette, who has been given the responsibility of delivering their family’s offering to their great tree. Despite their custom of making sure the men in the family bear the responsibility, she must deliver their family flower due to her dad's declining health. She will learn the strength of perseverance through the difficulties that she will encounter.
